no_rerun.generator_calls: truth-only replay only; no cost construction, no solver, no decoder

r7_primary_unit_statement.consequence: S9 re-stratifies archived paired results at the TEMPLATE INSTANCE level. This is NOT the seed-level primary estimand of the R7 confirmatory test, so S9 is reported only as a structural-heterogeneity diagnostic.
forbidden_wording: template instances match the resampling unit of the main analysis

d_max_definition.primary: d_max = max over source nodes i of |{j : (i,j) is a NON-DECOY ground-truth truth edge}|, i.e. over split union merge
d_max_definition.computed_from: ground-truth edges ONLY (never from predictions, never from transport support)
d_max_definition.cross_check: d_max_including_decoys is recorded and must equal d_max because every decoy pair is 1-to-1
d_max_definition.sampled_split_degree_cross_check: compared against the archived generator metadata; truth-derived d_max is authoritative if they differ

estimands.source: Tier A: recomputed independently from ARCHIVED prediction edge sets and archived truth edges
estimands.stratum_macro_effect: within each bridge, mean delta_H1 over that bridge's template instances in the stratum; then equal-weight mean over the three bridges

bootstrap.design: within each bridge, resample that bridge's stratum template instances WITH replacement; UOT_KR and HUNGARIAN move together as a paired observation; per-bridge mean; equal-weight mean over the three bridges

missing_bridge_rule.trigger: a bridge has n = 0 in a stratum
action: optionally report an available-bridge descriptive effect
never compare it directly with a complete three-bridge stratum

dependence_sensitivity.design: within each bridge resample SEED clusters with replacement, then keep the stratum template instances belonging to the sampled seeds
dependence_sensitivity.purpose: check whether the template-level bootstrap is over-optimistic because of family/template dependence

oracle_ceiling.definition: per template, maximum-cardinality bipartite matching on the ground-truth POSITIVE graph
oracle_ceiling.status: label-informed one-to-one semantic ceiling; NOT a deployable baseline

trend_test.question: does delta_H1 change linearly with d_max?
trend_test.observed_slope: within each bridge, center d_max and center delta_H1, then ordinary least squares slope; beta_macro = equal-weight mean of the three bridge slopes
trend_test.null: degree-association slope = 0, while each bridge may keep a non-zero mean H1
trend_test.permutation: per bridge, take the centered paired-difference residuals delta_H1 - bridge_mean_delta; multiply each independently by random +/-1; add the original bridge mean back; keep d_max fixed; recompute the three-bridge macro slope
trend_test.why_not_spearman: the analysis object is a PAIRED METHOD DIFFERENCE; the question is whether that paired effect changes with structural degree, so a locked paired-difference slope permutation is used. Any Spearman value is diagnostics only.

P_positive_trend.text: 事后分层分析显示，UOT-KR 相对一对一指派基线的优势随真值源级扇出复杂度增加而增强。R7 全体样本中的总体 H1 效应因此部分受到大量低度模板的稀释。该结果为结构复杂度依赖的收益提供了事后证据，但不改变原预注册 H1 判定。
P_positive_trend.extra: if the exact-degree means are not pointwise monotone, write 'positive overall trend', never 'strictly monotonic increase'

N_no_detectable_trend.text: 本事后分析未检测到 H1 效应随源级最大扇出度系统变化的证据。因此，“总体 +0.0255 主要被低度模板稀释”的解释未得到本分析支持。
N_no_detectable_trend.extra: p >= 0.05 must NOT be written as proof that the effect is flat

D_negative_trend.text: H1 效应随真值扇出复杂度增加反而下降，与预期的结构稀释解释方向相反。该事后结果需作为局限和进一步机制研究对象明确报告。

allowed_if_P: supports the hypothesis that benefits are larger under higher fan-out complexity
forbidden: proves that many-to-many output semantics caused the H1 gain
claim_limits.h1_confound_note: H1 still compares UOT-KR against a cost-optimal one-to-one baseline and therefore mixes a decoder difference with an output-constraint difference
claim_limits.oracle_wording: if the ceiling decreases with degree, one may say 'the representational capacity of a one-to-one output space decreases as the truth graph becomes more one-to-many'; one must NOT say Hungarian performance must equal the ceiling
